protocol.mape: 100 * mean(abs(pred-true)/abs(true)); excludes abs(true)<=epsilon; equal-weight mean across targets
protocol.wmape_pooled: 100 * sum(abs(pred-true)) / sum(abs(true)); includes zero-target error in numerator
protocol.epsilon_rule: max(1e-8, 1e-6 * training mean absolute target), original units, same mask for every model
